subject: Temporary capacity top-up for June launch — pricing & amendment
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightmarkets.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T09:14:00-04:00
Subject: Spike window — temporary quota increase?

Hi Priya,

Quick one — our team at BrightMarkets is planning a product promotion the week of June 20–24 and we expect a ~3x traffic spike to the inference endpoints. We want to avoid throttling but today’s quota will be insufficient.

Can Redwood do a short-term quota top-up or temporary rate-limit increase for that window? We need a clear price and a one-week contract amendment (or invoice) we can sign quickly. Also: do you have any launch credits or coupons that could offset the cost?

Appreciate a quick runbook/price before EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, BrightMarkets
liam.oconnor@brightmarkets.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightmarkets.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T11:08:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Spike window — temporary quota increase?

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up. Short answer: yes, we can provide a temporary capacity top-up for a one-week window.

Options we typically offer:
- Short-term headroom (one-week): scale to N x baseline (you suggested ~3x). Priced pro-rata at your committed unit rate.
- Elastic burst package: one-off surge fee + token surcharge.
- Launch credit: discretionary one-time credit applied to the invoice if an amendment is signed within the next 5 business days.

To be concrete, can you confirm: 1) baseline QPS / monthly committed tokens, and 2) estimated peak token volume for the week? I attached a quick spreadsheet template that we can fill to produce a firm number.

I’ve looped in Marissa (revenue approvals) and Ben (billing) to confirm discount/credit flexibility — Priya

Attachments: launch_estimate.xlsx
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T08:56:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Spike window — temporary quota increase? — proposal ask

Team — forwarding BrightMarkets request. They expect a ~3x spike for 5 days (~June 20–24). Quick proposed structure for approval:

Proposal A (preferred, simplifies billing):
- Temporary headroom: increase committed cap to 3x baseline for 2026-06-20T00:00 to 2026-06-24T23:59
- Billing: prorated at committed token rate; add a 15% discount to the token surcharge for the window
- One-time launch credit: $10,000 if amendment signed by Friday 6/11
- No change to ongoing commit beyond the window

Proposal B (conservative):
- Elastic surge: apply 1.5x surcharge to overage beyond baseline; no upfront credit; 10% discount for first invoice post-launch

Asks: margin impact OK at 15% discount for one week? Can Ben confirm any invoicing constraints for the prorated amendment? I attached a draft amendment we could send.

Thanks — Priya

Attachments: amendment_draft_v1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T10:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spike window — temporary quota increase? — proposal ask

Priya — I’m OK with Proposal A at 15% discount for a one-week window provided Legal signs off on the amendment language that limits exposure (explicit end time and a rollback to baseline). Please ensure the amendment: 1) sets exact UTC window, 2) caps total prorated liability at a maximum ($75k) so we don't get open-ended.

Ben — can we do the one-time $10k launch credit as a contra to the invoice if doc is signed by 6/11? Also confirm we can bill prorated token usage on the next monthly invoice and apply the credit at that time.

Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T11:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spike window — temporary quota increase? — proposal ask

All — confirmed. Finance can handle a prorated amendment and apply the $10k credit on the following invoice. We will cap exposure at $75,000 for the window in the amendment language. Need procurement contact for billing remit details.

-Ben
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightmarkets.com>, procurement@brightmarkets.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T09:18:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Spike window — temporary quota increase?

Hi Liam — confirmed, and thanks for the prompt details you sent back on baseline and peak estimates. Here’s the executive summary and next steps: 

What we’ll provide
- Temporary headroom: scale to 3x baseline from 2026-06-20T00:00:00Z through 2026-06-24T23:59:59Z (UTC).
- Billing: prorated token usage billed at your committed per-token rate with a 15% discount applied to the window’s billable rate.
- One-time launch credit of $10,000 applied to the invoice if the amendment is signed by EOD 2026-06-11.
- Liability cap: $75,000 for the window (amendment will include this clause).

Action items for BrightMarkets
- Sign the attached short amendment (DocuSign link below) by 2026-06-11 to secure the launch credit.
- Send billing remit and PO number to Ben (ben.carter@redwood.com) for invoicing.

I’ve attached the draft amendment for review; DocuSign will be sent once we have a confirm. If you prefer the surge package option instead, let me know and we can re-price.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/amendment/BM-2026-0887
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/BM-2026-0887

Thanks — looking forward to supporting the launch.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightmarkets.com>

Priya — this looks great, thank you. We’ll sign the amendment and route the PO to Ben today. Confirming we accept the terms (3x headroom, 15% discount, $10k credit with the 6/11 signature deadline).

Liam
